title: Leading coefficient of a Krawtchouk summand
statement: For all natural numbers $n,j,k$, the leading coefficient of the $k$th summand in the defining sum for the Krawtchouk polynomial of parameters $n,j$ is $(-1)^k(k!)^{-1}((j-k)!)^{-1}(-1)^{j-k}$.
